title: Finder/verifier agents grant unrestricted Bash while prompts claim read-only
description: Agents declare tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash with no command allowlist while promising read-only use. Affects agents/reviso-finder-history.md:4, agents/reviso-finder-prior-reviews.md:4, agents/reviso-verifier.md:4. Hostile commit messages can induce destructive commands (git checkout, rm, git commit). Fix by scoping Bash to specific subcommands: Bash(git blame:*), Bash(git log:*), Bash(git show:*), Bash(git diff:*) for history finders; Bash(gh pr list:*), Bash(gh pr view:*), Bash(gh search:*) for prior-reviews.
